description: M5 reliability benchmark: the 19 scenarios in docs/ENGINEERING_PLAN.md, with expected behaviour fixed before any result. Read only by the evaluator and tests, never at runtime. 'component' is a deterministic check of the code path the scenario depends on (no Gemini). 'live' names the recorded live case, if any, that ran the same question end to end. API failures are simulated with fake clients and labelled as simulated.

scenarios.scenario: Which high-risk portfolio has the largest Technology exposure?

component.condition_sql: SELECT portfolio_name FROM portfolios WHERE target_risk_level = 'High'
